text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali says in interview with Italian news agency that Arab Maghreb Union (AMU) is a necessity for cooperation and stability in the region.
- Organisation of the Islamic Conference (OIC) secretary- general Azeddine Laraki said Tunisia was supporting the OIC in all areas.
- President Ben Ali instructed Social Affairs Minister Chedli Neffati to make easier the integration of handicapped people in society and in the economy.
- Second international exhibition of motor industry to be held in Tunis from June 7-15.
- Italian ambassador in Tunis Rocco Antonio Cangelosi said President Ben Ali's visit to Italy is important in order to reinforce bilateral partenership.
- Parliament on Tuesday adopted a law to set up an agency for promotion of the audio-visual sector.
